AnalysisLimits.description: Analysis limit bounds for search area.

BlockSearchObject.description: A block search object: one point, a line or a window.

DepthReference.description:
Where the depth of an `s-f-depth` material is measured from. Another
string is kept as it is, for validation to report.

DrawdownEnvelope.description:
The drawdown (R) envelope of a soil that does not drain during rapid
drawdown: the total-stress envelope of isotropically consolidated
undrained tests (cR, φR), for the three-stage drawdown analysis.

HeadLine.description: A head line: the elevation of the head along x.

LineLoadDefinition.description:
A line load of a definition; `angle`: inclination from the downward
vertical (°), positive towards +x; `y`: the elevation of the load point
(a point on a wall face; default the ground at x).

materialName.description: Deprecated: assign the materials of the regions with regionAssignments. Used only without regionAssignments (the region below the boundary's midpoint).

MaterialModel.description: A material model: unit weight and strength. `kind` names the model.

aboveWater.description:
The strength of the material above its water line (the phreatic
level), when it differs from the strength below it (for example drained
above and undrained below). It also applies everywhere when the
material has no water line. Its unit weight is this model's.

bBar.description:
B̄ (B-bar): the excess pore pressure at a slice base in this material
is B̄ times the vertical stress of the fill above it (the materials
with `b_bar_load`), added to the pore pressure of its water line: the
short-term pore pressure of a soft foundation under a new fill
(Skempton 1954; Bishop 1954). Not set: none.

bBarLoad.description:
The weight of this material (a fill) raises the pore pressure of materials with `b_bar` below it.
(`if (model.bBarLoad)`: any value by its truthiness.)

cFactor.description:
Combined-method c-factor: the drained c′ is `cohesion` × cFactor.
0 = not combined, so cFactor = 0 cannot give a combined material
with c′ = 0; that takes `cohesion` = 0, any other cFactor and
`cohesionUndrained` set.

cohesionRateOfChange.description: Rate of cohesion increase per metre below the reference elevation (kPa/m).

cohesionRefDepth.description:
Reference ELEVATION y (m, despite the name) where c = `cohesion`:
c = cohesion + (cohesionRefDepth − y_base) × cohesionRateOfChange.

cohesionUndrained.description: Undrained cohesion Su (kPa). Used by Combined method.

drawdownStrength.description:
The drawdown (R) envelope: with a rapid drawdown analysis
(SlopeDefinition.rapidDrawdown) the soil does not drain and takes the
undrained strength of the three-stage procedure (model/drawdown.ts).
Not set: free-draining, its drained strength throughout.

maxSuction.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.maxSuction`: largest matric suction (kPa) taken
into account, > 0. Not set: no limit.

phiB.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.phiB`: angle φb (°) of the strength increase with
matric suction, 0 ≤ φb < 90. Not set or 0: no suction strength.

ru.description:
Pore pressure ratio rᵤ = u / σv (Bishop & Morgenstern 1960): the pore
pressure at a slice base in this material is rᵤ times the weight of
the soil above it per unit width, added to the pore pressure of its
water line (if any). Not set: none.

line. Not set: `unit_weight` throughout.

anisotropy.description:
`UndrainedAnisotropy.anisotropy`: Su is multiplied by a factor that
depends on the slice base inclination α, given as [[α°, factor], …]
and interpolated linearly (constant beyond the ends), as

down in the direction of sliding (the active zone near the crest),
negative where it rises (the passive zone at the toe). For example
[[-45, 0.82], [0, 1], [60, 1.5]] for passive 0.82, direct 1.0 and active
1.5 relative to the direct shear strength. Analyses without a slip
surface base (finite elements, limit analysis, the strength profiles)
take the factor at α = 0. Not set or empty: isotropic.

suRefDepth.description: Reference ELEVATION y (m, despite the name) where Su = `undrainedShearStrength`.

The user supplies a set of data points with known c, φ, γ values.
At analysis time, the effective parameters are interpolated from
the nearest data points.

oneOf.title: SpatialMohrCoulombModel

oneOf.description:
Anisotropic function model.

Base c and φ are multiplied by a modifier that is a function of the
slice base inclination angle α. The modifier function is supplied
as an array of (α_deg, factor) pairs and linearly interpolated.
The factor scales φ in degrees, not tan φ: 0.8 on φ = 30° gives
24.0°, where 0.8·tan 30° would give 24.8°.

modifierFunction.description:
Modifier vs base inclination: [[α_deg, factor], …].

α is measured relative to the sliding direction, not geometrically:
positive where the slice base dips down in the direction of sliding
(the back scarp), negative where it rises (the toe). The same
function therefore applies unchanged to left- and right-facing slopes.

oneOf.title: AnisotropicFunctionModel

oneOf.description:
Strength as a function of depth.

φ = 0; Su = suRef + (depth − depthRef) × rate,
where depth = yTop − yBottom at the slice base centre, yTop being the
ground surface or the top of the material layer (see `depthReference`).

Combined (with `drainedCohesion` and `drainedFrictionAngle`): the
strength is the lesser of the undrained Su and the drained
c′ + σ′·tan φ′, with c′ = drainedCohesion + (depth − depthRef) ×
drainedCohesionRate at the same depth, as Swedish practice analyses
clay ("kombinerad analys") and commercial programs offer it.

depthRef.description: Reference depth (m) below the depth reference.

depthReference.description:
What the depth is measured from:
- "ground": the ground surface above the slice base;
- "layer-top": the top of the region of this material directly above
  the slice base (as commercial programs offer it); for the uppermost layer this is the ground.

Not set: "ground" (models saved before the option existed).

drainedCohesion.description:
Drained effective cohesion c′ (kPa) at the reference depth, for a
combined analysis. Set together with `drainedFrictionAngle`; either
not set: undrained only.

drainedCohesionRate.description: Change of c′ per metre of depth (kPa/m), with the same depth as Su. Not set: 0.

drainedFrictionAngle.description: Drained friction angle φ′ (°) for a combined analysis (see `drainedCohesion`).

rate.description: Rate of change of Su with depth (kPa/m); positive: Su increases downwards.

oneOf.title: StrengthFromDatumModel

oneOf.description:
Clay improved with lime-cement columns (KC-pelare): the shear strength of
the improved block is the area-weighted mean of the columns and the soil
between them, τ = a·τcol + (1 − a)·cu,soil. Undrained by default; with a
drained column strength (c′, φ′) the column part is limited to
c′ + σ′·tan φ′ ≤ cu,col (combined analysis), as in Swedish practice.

oneOf.description:

σ1′ = σ3′ + σci (mb σ3′/σci + s)^a from the intact rock's σci and mi,
the Geological Strength Index and the disturbance factor D. The analyses
use its instantaneous Mohr–Coulomb parameters at the normal stress on the
slip surface (types/hoek_brown.rs).

oneOf.title: HoekBrownModel

oneOf.description:
SHANSEP (Ladd & Foott 1974): the undrained strength from the effective
vertical stress at the slice base and the stress history,
Su = σ′v · S · OCR^m, with OCR constant or a function of elevation; or
Su as a function of σ′v. σ′v is the slice's weight and surface loads per
unit width less the pore pressure at its base (the overburden on the
base in the analysis's pore pressures), as commercial programs take it.

ocrByElevation.description: OCR against elevation, [[y, OCR], …], interpolated linearly (constant beyond the ends); replaces `ocr`.

phiB.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.phiB`: angle φb (°) of the strength increase with
matric suction, 0 ≤ φb < 90. Not set or 0: no suction strength.

pop.description:
Pre-overburden pressure POP (kPa): OCR = (σ′v + POP)/σ′v at the base.
Replaces `ocr` and `ocrByElevation`.

ratio.description: S, the Su/σ′v ratio of the normally consolidated soil.

ru.description:
Pore pressure ratio rᵤ = u / σv (Bishop & Morgenstern 1960): the pore
pressure at a slice base in this material is rᵤ times the weight of
the soil above it per unit width, added to the pore pressure of its
water line (if any). Not set: none.

spline.description: Cubic splines through `ocrByElevation` / `suByStress` instead of straight lines; constant beyond the ends as with straight lines.

suByStress.description: Su against σ′v, [[σ′v, Su], …], interpolated linearly (constant beyond the ends); replaces S, m and OCR.

unitWeightSat.description:
Saturated unit weight (kN/m³) for the soil below the material's water
line. Not set: `unit_weight` throughout.

yieldFromEarlierStage.description:
With an earlier stage (SlopeDefinition.earlierStage): the yield stress
is the effective vertical stress of the earlier stage at the base, with
its distributed loads over the base taken straight down (no spreading
with depth), plus `pop` (the stress history the soil kept from it),
OCR = σ′y/σ′v, at least 1.
(`yieldFromEarlierStage === true`: any other value is false.)

yieldStress.description: Yield (preconsolidation) stress σ′y (kPa): OCR = σ′y/σ′v at the base, at least 1. Replaces `ocr` and `ocrByElevation`.

oneOf.title: ShansepModel

oneOf.description:
A curved strength envelope given as points of the shear strength against
the effective normal stress, τ = f(σ′n), interpolated linearly between
them or with a spline (the end segment extended beyond the ends): each
slice base takes the tangent c and φ of the segment at its normal
stress, which the analysis updates from the stress it finds, as for
Hoek-Brown.

aboveWater.description:
The strength of the material above its water line (the phreatic
level), when it differs from the strength below it (for example drained
above and undrained below). It also applies everywhere when the
material has no water line. Its unit weight is this model's.

bBar.description:
B̄ (B-bar): the excess pore pressure at a slice base in this material
is B̄ times the vertical stress of the fill above it (the materials
with `b_bar_load`), added to the pore pressure of its water line: the
short-term pore pressure of a soft foundation under a new fill
(Skempton 1954; Bishop 1954). Not set: none.

bBarLoad.description:
The weight of this material (a fill) raises the pore pressure of materials with `b_bar` below it.
(`if (model.bBarLoad)`: any value by its truthiness.)

maxSuction.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.maxSuction`: largest matric suction (kPa) taken
into account, > 0. Not set: no limit.

phiB.description:
`UnsaturatedStrength.phiB`: angle φb (°) of the strength increase with
matric suction, 0 ≤ φb < 90. Not set or 0: no suction strength.

ru.description:
Pore pressure ratio rᵤ = u / σv (Bishop & Morgenstern 1960): the pore
pressure at a slice base in this material is rᵤ times the weight of
the soil above it per unit width, added to the pore pressure of its
water line (if any). Not set: none.

spline.description: A cubic spline through the points instead of straight lines (see `TableSpline`).

unitWeightSat.description:
Saturated unit weight (kN/m³) for the soil below the material's water
line. Not set: `unit_weight` throughout.

oneOf.title: ShearNormalModel

Pile.description:
Pile row (or sheet pile wall) resisting the sliding mass in shear: where
a slip surface crosses the pile axis, a force acts against the sliding
direction (see `direction`; by default tilted `angle` degrees upwards,
0: horizontal). Its size is the given shear force per pile, or —
without one, for a vertical pile — the Ito & Matsui (1975) lateral force
of the soil squeezing between the piles above the slip surface; either is
limited by the pile's shear and bending capacity. Per metre of slope:
divided by the spacing.

angle.description: Tilt of the force above horizontal (°), for direction "angle". Default 0.

axialStiffness.description: Axial stiffness EA per pile (kN), for the finite element analysis; default as `bendingStiffness`.

bendingStiffness.description: Bending stiffness EI per pile (kNm²), for the finite element analysis; default a solid circle of `diameter` in concrete (E = 30 GPa), or a plate for a wall.

diameter.description: Pile diameter / width (m), for Ito & Matsui.

direction.description:
Direction of the force. Default "angle" (with `angle`), so that saved
models keep their result; the usual default elsewhere is "tangent".

force.description: Shear force per pile (kN); omit for Ito & Matsui (needs the diameter).

location.description: Where an Ito & Matsui force acts. Default "centroid".

momentCapacity.description: Bending capacity per pile (kNm): force ≤ M / Lm, Lm the arm of the soil pressure.

spacing.description: Centre-to-centre spacing (m). Default 1 (a wall per metre).

wall.description:
A continuous wall (sheet piles): in the finite element analysis no soil
flows through it, and its default stiffness is that of a plate of
thickness `diameter` per metre. Default: a wall where spacing ≤ diameter.

PileForceDirection.description:
Direction of a pile's force on the sliding mass, always against the
movement:
- "angle": tilted `angle` degrees above horizontal (0: horizontal);
- "tangent": along the slip surface where it crosses the pile (the usual
  default, "tangential");
- "perpendicular": perpendicular to the pile axis (horizontal for a
  vertical pile).

Another string is kept (`Other`), as a JavaScript object keeps it, so
that `Slope::set_piles` reports it with TypeScript's message.

PileForceLocation.description:
Where an Ito & Matsui pile force acts: at the resultant of the soil
pressure on the pile above the slip surface ("centroid", the default),
or where the slip surface crosses the pile ("slip-surface", as Cai &
Ugai 2000, eq. 9, apply it). A given force acts at the crossing.

RapidDrawdown.description:
Rapid drawdown (three-stage, model/drawdown.ts): the water table before
drawdown, for all materials.

ReferenceLine.description: A reference line: where the head of its top and bottom head lines applies.

end1Capacity.description: Anchorage capacity at end 1 (plate, facing connection), kN per element. Default 0.

end2Capacity.description: Anchorage capacity at end 2, kN per element. Default 0.

prestress.description:
Lock-off (prestress) load of a grouted anchor's free length, kN per
element: the finite element analysis prestresses the free length with
it (the limit equilibrium takes an active element's force as its
capacity). Default 0.

pullout.description:
Pullout along the element. Without it both ends are fully anchored:
the tensile capacity is available wherever the element is crossed
(end-anchored bars).

spacing.description: Out-of-plane spacing (m); all capacities are divided by it. Default 1.

tensileCapacity.description:
Tensile capacity per element (kN), or per metre with spacing 1. Per
element means per strip or bar; a sheet with partial coverage (coverage
A) is entered as T·A per metre with spacing 1.

ReinforcementPullout.description:
Pullout resistance along the element (per element, per metre of its
length):
- "bond": a constant bond strength, over the whole element or only over
  the bonded length at end 2 (grouted tiebacks);
- "interface": r = 2·(a + σ′v·tan δ)·Rc per metre of slope, soil
  bearing on both faces of a sheet, with σ′v the effective vertical
  stress at the element (the weight of the soil column above it less the
  pore pressure) and Rc the coverage ratio (1 for a continuous sheet,
  strip width / spacing for strips; FHWA's F*·α·σ′v·C·Rc). Rc only sets
  the width of soil contact: the tensile and end capacities are per
  element (per strip), so they are not multiplied by it. A
  geosynthetic "coverage" A (as commercial programs define it) scales all strengths given per metre of
  material width (T·A, (C + 2·L·τ)·A); there enter the tensile and end
  capacities × A with spacing 1 (per metre of slope), and coverage A;
- "development": the tensile capacity develops linearly over the given
  length from each end (0: that end is fully anchored).

SlopeMaterialDefinition.description: A material of a slope definition.

depthRange.description: Depth range [top, bottom] in m for this material.

model.description:
The material: unit weight and strength. The only source of them; see
`material_model_of` for definitions written before models existed.
(`if (m.model)`: a value that is not truthy, `null` included, is none.)

unitWeight.description:
Deprecated: older definitions without `model` gave a Mohr-Coulomb
material in these flat fields. Read only when `model` is absent.

waterTableId.description:
Id of an entry in `water_tables` that governs pore pressure in this
material. When absent (or unknown) the default `water_table` is used.
`Some(None)` is `null`: TypeScript assigns it (`waterTableId !==
undefined`), so the material counts as having its own water table
while it uses the default one.

SpatialInterpolation.description:
Interpolation method of a spatial Mohr-Coulomb model. Another value
(a string or of another type) is kept as it is (TypeScript falls back to
inverse distance weighting).

TableSpline.description:
A cubic spline through a table's points: natural (zero curvature) at an
end without a slope, clamped to the slope given; a straight line with
the end slope beyond the ends (math/spline.rs).

excessPorePressure.description: Excess pore pressure under the load per material (UdlParams.excessPorePressure).

UdlExcessPorePressure.description: Excess pore pressure under a load in one material (see `UdlParams::excess_pore_pressure`).

followBoundary.description: Deprecated: use freeWater (followBoundary = !freeWater). true: the line is clipped to the ground (no free water).

freeWater.description: Whether water above the ground surface is free water whose weight acts on the ground (true), or the line is clipped to the ground (false, the default).

WaterTableEntry.description:
An additional water table (piezometric line) that materials can refer
to with `water_table_id`.

followBoundary.description: Deprecated: use freeWater (followBoundary = !freeWater). true: the line is clipped to the ground (no free water).

freeWater.description: Whether water above the ground surface is free water whose weight acts on the ground (true), or the line is clipped to the ground (false, the default).

WaterTableMode.description:
Water table mode (`SlopeDefinition.waterTable.mode`). Another value
(`null` and a missing mode included: `Missing`) is kept, and the water
table is then left out, as `buildSlope` leaves it.

WaterTableValue.description:
`SlopeDefinition.waterTable.value`: a level (height or depth) or the
points of a custom line. Another value (`null`, a string, a list that is
not of points, a missing value) is kept, and the water table is then
left out, as `buildSlope` leaves it where the value does not fit the
mode.

headLines.description: Head lines by id: the elevation of the head along x.

phreaticLineId.description: The head line that is the phreatic line (above all reference lines).

referenceLines.description: Reference lines: where the head of their top and bottom head lines applies.

description:
A slope model: the outline (coordinates), the materials and their regions (materialBoundaries, regionAssignments), water, loads, structures and the search limits. Coordinates in metres, y up; the model slides towards +x unless orientation is "rtl".

The schema is stricter than the engine: the engine also reads values of another type as the app's earlier TypeScript engine did (a number of another type as no number, an unknown option as the default) and ignores unknown keys, while this schema accepts only JSON numbers, the documented strings, integers for counts, and known keys. cslope.validate (validate_definition) checks a document against it and adds the rules of the model (regions, boundaries, ranges).

analysisLimits.description: Search area limits for entry/exit ranges.

blockSearchObjects.description:
Block search objects (analysis option `searchMethod: "block"`): each
block surface passes through one point of every object. One point is
a fixed point, two points a line, three or more a window (polygon).

customPlanesOnly.description: When true, only the custom surfaces are analysed (no search).

customSearchPlanes.description:
User-specified circular search planes (cx, cy, radius), in model space
(the coordinates of this definition, also for a right-to-left slope).
`analyse` with `map_analysis_result_to_model_space` returns results in
model space; a Slope's own surfaces (`Slope.search`) are in canonical
space, taken back with `Slope.toModelX` / `Slope.toModelCircle`.

customSurfaces.description:
User-specified non-circular surfaces: polylines through the soil. They
are fitted to the ground (end segments extended to it) and analysed
with moments about a default axis point, or about `axis` when given
(the circle centre an optimised surface was derived from).

earlierStage.description:
An earlier stage of the same section (its geometry, water and loads),
whose effective vertical stresses give the yield stress of SHANSEP
materials with `yieldFromEarlierStage` (multi-stage analyses). Its x
range must be the model's. (TypeScript's type leaves out its own
`earlierStage`.)

lineLoads.description:
Line loads; `angle`: inclination from the downward vertical (°),
positive towards +x; `y`: the elevation of the load point (a point on a
wall face; default the ground at x).

materialBoundaries.description: Material boundary polylines that divide the slope into layers.

materials.description:
Material assignments. Absent reads as none, which `build_slope`
rejects with TypeScript's message (TypeScript's `!def.materials`).

orientation.description: Model orientation used for canonical mirroring.

piles.description: Pile rows and sheet pile walls (shear).

rapidDrawdown.description:
Rapid drawdown (three-stage, model/drawdown.ts): the water table before
drawdown, for all materials (the model's own water is the state after
it). The materials with a drawdown envelope do not drain.

regionAssignments.description:
Point-based region material assignments.
Each entry maps a representative point to a material name.
The engine assigns the material to whichever region contains the point.

reinforcements.description: Reinforcement: anchors, tiebacks, soil nails, geosynthetics.

topRegionMaterialName.description:
Material name for the top region (above all boundaries).
Only needed when it differs from the first (default) material.

waterTables.description:
Additional water tables (piezometric lines) that materials can refer
to with `waterTableId`. Same clipping rule as `waterTable`.

waternet.description:
Pore pressure from head lines and reference lines (model/waternet.rs),
for all materials instead of their water lines (which still give the
phreatic level for unit weights, free water and `aboveWater`).
